enabled.description: `true` if the Selective Forward feature is enabled.

defaultPhoneNumberToForward.description: The phone number to which calls are forwarded by default when the criteria conditions are met.

ringReminderEnabled.description: If `true`, a brief tone will be played on the person's phone when a call has been forwarded.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Indicates whether calls that meet the criteria are forwarded to the destination phone number's voicemail.

criteria.description: A list of criteria specifying conditions when selective accept is in effect.
